hero.subhead: People fly with half-empty bags every day. Use that space, or earn from yours.

about.title: What Viactor is
about.body: Viactor creates no transportation. It matches people who are already flying with people who need something moved. Couriers here are independent users, never employees. The platform handles matching, chat and payment, and takes its fee only when a deal completes.

status.title: Where the project stands
status.body: The whole loop already works end to end: post a listing, match, talk, hand over, review. The platform runs on its own hardware and answers to no marketplace.

how_page.intro: Two kinds of listing, one shared route.
how_page.step1: Match. Your listing and their listing point at the same route and overlapping dates.
how_page.step2: Talk it over. Price, what exactly flies, when and where you meet.
how_page.step3: Both confirm, and the fee is held until the handover is done.
how_page.step4: Meet, check the item together, confirm. Reviews go both ways.

routes.title: Where we open first
routes.note: Your route is not here yet? Post it anyway. Listings are what open a corridor.

price.body: You two agree it between yourselves. No per-kilo tariff, no customs broker, no fuel surcharge.
price.title: The fee

safety_page.id_title: ID verification, checked by a human
safety_page.id_body: Verification is optional, and it is not a rubber stamp: a person reviews each request, duplicate documents across accounts are flagged, and the photos are deleted the moment a decision is made. A verified badge means we checked. It is deterrence, not a guarantee.
safety_page.escrow_body: The sender pays, and the money waits. It goes to the courier only after both sides confirm the handover and the receipt. If the deal never happens, there is nothing to release: pre-launch the platform takes nothing and holds nothing.
safety_page.reviews_body: After a completed deal, each side reviews the other, anchored to that exact transaction. Reviews attach to the deal snapshot, so a listing closing or an account renaming does not launder a track record.
safety_page.decide_body: Nothing is automatic. You choose who carries your item, what you agree to carry, and where you meet. Talk before you confirm, ask for details, and step away from any deal that feels wrong. A ban is one message away.

founders.title: It is just the two of us
founders.body: No logistics group, no investor deck. Two people who got tired of paying 60 euro to send a 2 kg box to family, and of it arriving opened. Write to us and you get one of us, not a ticket number.
